text: {"features":[{"name":"Advanced academic training","description":"How far the applicant's formal education exceeds the role's minimum baseline in a directly relevant technical field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent and does not show education beyond the minimum baseline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a relevant bachelor's degree and presents it as a credible technical foundation, but still shows no graduate-level preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a relevant master's degree or equivalent advanced graduate study."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctoral degree or similarly deep academic training in a technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"States doctoral-level or otherwise exceptional academic preparation and clearly presents it as especially relevant to the role's technical demands."}]},{"name":"Professional software experience","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates meaningful experience testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline professional experience, such as roughly the minimum years and limited evidence of owning production launches or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows solid early-career production experience with some direct involvement in testing, maintaining, or launching software."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows repeated responsibility across multiple production services over several years."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows broad production experience across several services or a long enough span to suggest confident system ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially deep production experience with sustained responsibility across many maintained and launched production systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows professional fluency with Go for the back-end work central to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go without showing that it is a meaningful professional tool for the applicant."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says Go is a main language but gives no concrete example of relevant work built in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular professional use of Go for production services or infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear example of using Go for role-relevant back-end, platform, or control-plane systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong, role-specific Go depth through multiple concrete examples of back-end infrastructure or guardrail-heavy systems built in Go."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates substantive Python use for tooling, automation, services, or analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it only in passing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims Python familiarity but gives little sense of depth or use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tooling, automation, services, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples of Python as an important implementation language for role-relevant work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, production-grade Python use, such as core automation layers, tested services, or central use in agentic systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter evidences practical strength with algorithms and data-structure choice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of algorithmic skill or thoughtful data-structure choice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States comfort with algorithms or data structures but offers no concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one clear example of using algorithmic thinking or structure choice to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a technically credible example showing meaningful gains in performance, simplicity, or tractability from algorithmic work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong algorithmic maturity through specific, substantial examples that make the applicant sound fluent rather than merely familiar."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on work applying modern AI systems in production settings relevant to reliability and evaluation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI or language-model work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without showing hands-on implementation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on work with AI-backed features or workflows in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical awareness of evaluation, reliability, or guardrail needs when shipping AI systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial production AI experience with clear discussion of trustworthy deployment, evaluation, and failure modes."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that coordinate autonomous agents with explicit constraints or supervision.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing agentic or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomy in broad terms without explaining how the system works or is controlled."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-based tooling with a plausible division of work between agents and services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a credible agentic architecture, such as Python agents paired with Go services that constrain or audit actions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong agentic-systems design through detailed emphasis on permissions, supervision, logging, boundaries, or other control mechanisms needed for safe deployment."}]},{"name":"Security assessment ability","description":"How clearly the letter shows the ability to perform security assessments of systems, designs, or code.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments vaguely, without saying what was assessed or how."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States concrete security assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or reviewing existing services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment practice with attention to attack surface, findings, or validating remediation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a substantive professional capability, with clear methodology and hands-on, builder-minded judgment."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How well the letter demonstrates direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related handling workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of automating vulnerability workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions vulnerability work but not clear ownership of automation or triage systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or improving automation for vulnerability intake, triage, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete picture of the automated workflow, such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, or routing that reduced manual effort."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of vulnerability-handling automation with clear operational impact and a system view of triage at scale."}]},{"name":"Systems design sophistication","description":"How strongly the letter conveys ability to design reliable back-end or distributed systems beyond routine application work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of nontrivial back-end or distributed systems design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions infrastructure or back-end interest without technically demanding examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes one concrete example of meaningful systems design, such as a high-throughput service, scheduler, or internal platform component."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows credible experience with difficult systems concerns such as consistency, coordination, throughput, exactness, or reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates unusually strong systems-design maturity through multiple or especially demanding examples of back-end or distributed engineering."}]},{"name":"Role-specific insight","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the actual engineering problem in this role, especially scaling security work through automation, developer enablement, and lifecycle integration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a generic software or security application and does not show understanding of this team's problem space."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in security or infrastructure but stays at a broad level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the role to at least one specific theme such as reducing manual security work, helping developer teams, or platform leverage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear understanding of how automation and embedded safeguards can scale security impact across an organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates a nuanced view of the role as a systems problem, such as scaling scarce expertise, variant analysis, or making secure defaults real throughout the development lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Google-specific motivation","description":"How compellingly the letter explains why this applicant wants this particular role at Google rather than a generic security engineering job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little or no reason for pursuing this specific role at Google."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses generic enthusiasm for Google, security, or scale without a clearly personal rationale."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible reason tied to Google's scale, platform impact, or the team mission."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows well-matched motivation grounded in the applicant's own values, career direction, and the team's remit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a highly convincing, specific case that this role at Google is a deliberate next step rather than a broadly targeted application."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How much the letter supports its claims with concrete, observable examples, outcomes, or technical details.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad assurances of capability or interest with minimal supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few concrete facts, but many important claims remain generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with specific examples of projects, redesigns, responsibilities, or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly grounds claims in concrete technical work and observable results, making the applicant easy to picture in the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently lets evidence do the persuasion through precise, substantive examples and clear outcomes rather than self-description."}]},{"name":"External security signals","description":"How much the letter provides credible security depth signals through certifications, competition practice, or comparable outside evidence.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no external signal of security practice or depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light or occasional security practice with limited evidence of seriousness."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a solid signal through regular capture-the-flag participation or a baseline security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows stronger security credibility through OSCP-level certification, near-top competition performance, or comparable hands-on evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents exceptional security depth through multiple strong external signals or an unusually demanding level of demonstrated practice."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"How strongly the letter shows contributions to or maintenance of software used beyond the applicant's immediate team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only light or occasional open-source activity with little sense of continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes contributing fixes or patches upstream when needed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing open-source involvement, such as regular contributions or maintenance of a project with external users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial open-source stewardship, with clear responsibility for a project, releases, reviews, or an outside user community."}]},{"name":"Independent initiative","description":"How well the letter uses personal projects or other self-directed work to demonstrate curiosity, follow-through, and technical ambition.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of self-directed technical work outside core job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project mainly as a hobby or light practice signal."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a completed personal build that shows initiative and some relevant engineering skill."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses a self-directed project to demonstrate meaningful technical ambition, such as distributed systems, reliability, or other nontrivial challenges."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through sustained personal engineering work that tackles difficult design problems and clearly strengthens role fit."}]},{"name":"Writing structure","description":"How clearly and persuasively the letter is organized, with a coherent narrative or argument rather than a loose list of facts.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed or hard to follow, with abrupt transitions or fragment-like sections."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but reads mostly as a list of qualifications with limited narrative cohesion."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is clearly organized and easy to follow, even if the structure is conventional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a coherent and persuasive progression from motivation to evidence to fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Reads as a well-shaped argument whose structure actively strengthens the case for the applicant."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level, including spelling, typing, and general proofreading accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent noticeable spelling, typing, or proofreading errors that repeatedly interrupt reading."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors that meaningfully reduce polish but do not obscure the main message."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a few minor errors or awkward slips while remaining generally professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is very clean, with only rare if any minor mechanical mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and fully polished at the sentence level."}]}]}
